name: PixiMotion refuses a stale source and a fresh capture bakes as one reversible edit
description: Undoing source artwork after capturing a motion part must disable baking; recapturing the restored artwork allows a three-frame translation whose pixels and timeline Undo and Redo together.

planSteps.description: Open the local studio with a new 32 by 32 drawing.
Paint a recognizable small mark in the middle of the canvas as one stroke.
Select the mark without moving its pixels.
Click Undo once to undo the painted source stroke.
Verify the original canvas is blank, the motion panel explains that the source artwork changed, and Bake to Timeline is disabled. Creating a part must not add an Undo step.
Click Redo once to restore the original mark.
Select the restored mark with the box selection tool.
Click Create Motion Part for a fresh capture.
Set END pose translation X to four pixels using the labeled slider and keyboard arrows.
Set the motion frame count to three using its labeled slider.
Verify three timeline frames exist, the last frame is selected, the last mark is displaced four canvas pixels right of its original coordinates, and the motion session closes.
Verify the timeline returns to one frame and its raster exactly matches the original painted mark, including transparent pixels.
Verify all three baked frames and their exact translated pixels return, with the last frame selected.
